verdict.summary: The extracted poller preserves the existing approval policy while replacing the silently truncated issue-list query with exhaustive REST pagination, filtering pull requests, failing closed on fetch errors/runaway snapshots, and checking the trust-boundary label-removal result before applying triage writes. The hermetic self-test exercises the real driver seam with more than 200 quarantined issues, an old approved issue, stale and outsider approvals, malformed timestamps, dry-run behavior, PR filtering, and failed un-quarantine behavior; it passes at the PR head. Workflow wiring runs both policy and driver self-tests before the write-enabled poll. No correctness, soundness, security, or vacuity defect was found in the changed scope.
